{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Find the 6 rows with revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Check if they are in the population of interest: NEW and paid_search
qa_in_target = qa_rows[(qa_rows['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (qa_rows['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Count how many QA rows are in the target group
num_qa_in_target = len(qa_in_target)
print(f'Number of QA rows in NEW + paid_search: {num_qa_in_target}')

# If any, check their converted status
if num_qa_in_target > 0:
    print('\nConverted status of QA rows in target group:')
    print(qa_in_target['converted'].value_counts())
    # They are all converted (1), so they would inflate the conversion rate if included
    # But they are not real customers — they must be excluded
    print('\nTherefore, we must exclude QA rows from the analysis.')"}
